checks: Multi-image import preserves original raster fingerprint and resolution
Pixel pitch/effective magnification produce labeled theoretical scale only; measured calibration stays distinct
Invalid/unknown scale cannot yield a trusted physical-unit decision
Zoom changes viewport only
Attachments distinguish uploaded/readable/parsed/used; no 3D required
Automatic target candidate remains editable
Polygon creation/move/delete and undo affect the actual target definition
Target identity is not silently changed by later attachment parsing
Generic object and child feature can be named and linked by relation
Missing relation/identity information prompts once without inventing it
Second inspection reuses existing product identity
Multiple images can have different answers per inspection item with reasons
Same image width OK and feature NG coexist
Unlabeled examples are excluded from comparison; original manual answer never overwritten
At least width and another independent measurement/rule execute actual raster algorithms
Method/ROI change invalidates dependent results
Missing physical calibration blocks only operations needing physical units
Batch computes each raster, rather than copying reference-image result
False accept, false reject, UNKNOWN and unmatched labels are separately visible
Failed localization cannot become confident NG or OK
Release captures dependencies and later relevant edits mark stale
Save/reopen retains geometry, example answers/reasons, product knowledge, calibration and source states
Pi slash commands are handled locally and never sent as ordinary LLM prompts
Unknown slash command gives actionable local feedback

results.name: Current canvas import plus retained recipe API closed loop; no removed seven-page wizard assertion
Pi slash commands are handled locally, including unknown commands; zero LLM prompt calls
Original image fingerprint preserved; adaptive left/right edge search succeeds, while uncalibrated mm remains UNKNOWN until measured calibration is supplied
